about: The workspace index's reducer (web/workspace/sync-reduce.ts): each vector's ops from an empty index, in seq order, give `expect` (by path; trashedFrom for an entry put in Trash) and skip the ops in `skipped`. Shared with the server (design/sync-server.md §3).

vectors.name: rename and a write across devices
vectors.about: B renames a file while A writes it: both apply, to the one identity

vectors.name: two renames of one file
vectors.about: the later by seq wins

vectors.name: a path reused after a rename
vectors.about: a write names its identity, so it reaches the renamed file, not the new one at its old path

vectors.name: write after Trash
vectors.about: the edit wins: the file comes back out of Trash

vectors.name: write after its folder went to Trash
vectors.about: the folder comes back with it

vectors.name: write after forget
vectors.about: forgotten for good: the write is a copy at its last path, its identity derived

vectors.name: two writes from one base
vectors.about: the later by seq becomes a conflict copy beside it

vectors.name: a copy of a copy
vectors.about: a third device's write from the old base is another copy; writes to a copy name its derived identity, and conflict with each other the same way

vectors.name: a conflict copy's name taken
vectors.about: the copy takes the first free (2)

vectors.name: creates colliding three ways
vectors.about: the first by seq keeps the name; the others take (2) and (3), keeping their own identities

vectors.name: names that look the same
vectors.about: an NFD name beside its NFC form, and the Kelvin sign beside K, are one path: the later takes (2)

vectors.name: a create in a folder removed meanwhile
vectors.about: the folder is made again, with an identity derived from the create; the one in Trash stays

vectors.name: a create in a folder renamed meanwhile
vectors.about: a create names its path: the old folder's path is made again

vectors.name: a folder renamed with what is in it
vectors.about: everything in it moves

vectors.name: a folder into itself
vectors.about: skipped: nothing moves

vectors.name: a rename onto a taken path
vectors.about: it takes (2)

vectors.name: restore when its place is taken
vectors.about: it comes back as (2)

vectors.name: restore into a folder gone meanwhile
vectors.about: the folder is made again

vectors.name: a rename of what is in Trash
vectors.about: the later op wins: it comes out to where the rename says

vectors.name: two removes into Trash with one name
vectors.about: the second takes (2) in Trash

vectors.name: a resent create
vectors.about: the same identity made twice: once

vectors.name: documents by their ref
vectors.about: a notebook and a board: renamed, removed, restored by ref; a rename to another kind's name is skipped

vectors.name: ops that can't apply
vectors.about: each is skipped, and the ops after them still apply

vectors.name: a chosen fid equal to a derived folder's
vectors.about: the folder made for the create takes the next identity of its series; the file with that fid stays

vectors.name: an op's own fid equal to its derived folder's
vectors.about: the folder takes the next identity; the file keeps its own

vectors.name: a conflict copy's identity taken
vectors.about: the copy takes the next identity of its series

vectors.name: a long name's (2)
vectors.about: shortened so the name stays within 255 characters

vectors.name: a long name's conflict copy
vectors.about: shortened so the copy's name stays within 255 characters

vectors.name: a move that would make a path too long
vectors.about: skipped whole: the folder and what is in it stay where they were, and the folders its path would have made aren't left behind

vectors.name: a create whose folder can't be made
vectors.about: the folder's name is a file's, so it would be (2), and the path too long: skipped whole, no folder left behind

vectors.name: a write to an unseen identity at the root or in Trash
vectors.about: skipped: nothing is made at / or in Trash

vectors.name: a create in a folder renamed meanwhile, by parent
vectors.about: the create follows its folder by identity

vectors.name: a create by parent, the old path reused
vectors.about: a new folder at the old path doesn't take it: the create follows its folder

vectors.name: a create by parent, the folder forgotten
vectors.about: by its path, then: into the folder there now

vectors.name: a create by parent, the folder in Trash
vectors.about: the edit wins: the folder comes back, the file in it

vectors.name: a rename by parent into a folder renamed meanwhile
vectors.about: it lands in that folder, where it is now

vectors.name: a restore by parent into a folder renamed meanwhile
vectors.about: it comes back into that folder, where it is now

vectors.name: parent naming a file, or a folder inside the one moved
vectors.about: a file's fid: by the path; a folder into its own: skipped

vectors.name: parent where it can't be
vectors.about: on a remove, or not a fid: the op is skipped
